text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both modestly higher over 24 hours, with ETH tracking BTC's gains and no meaningful divergence between the two majors. Fear & Greed sits at 27 (fear territory) but has climbed 12 points in a week, suggesting sentiment is stabilizing after a recent dip. The relatively flat volume at $88B and Bitcoin's stable 55.8% dominance indicate consolidation rather than conviction—neither panic nor breakout momentum is present.
